title: registerContractHistory
responsibility: Registers contracts diff, log and last CLI arguments, snapshot selectors, filters, limits and JSON or terminal output actions.

inputs.name: registerContractHistory.contracts
inputs.description: Existing Commander contracts group to which read-only diff, log and last subcommands are attached; registration performs no snapshot reads.

outputs.name: registerContractHistory
outputs.description: No value; installs three Commander commands, their validation and deferred read-only output actions.

errors.name: InvalidArgumentError
errors.description: Installed limit parsers reject tokens that are not positive safe decimal integers without leading zeros.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError or Error
errors.description: Deferred command actions propagate contract, revision, filesystem and Git diagnostics; registration itself performs no reads.
